About the tune

  • Music (1860): Ira David Sankey (1840–1908)

Metre: Irregular.

Melody from the Christian Classics Ethereal Hymnary (CCEH, public domain); tune INTERCESSION (SANKEY) by Ira David Sankey (1840–1908). The CCEH gives its tunes as four-part scores; this page has the melody only, read from its MIDI file and checked against its incipit, and NoteFusion's engine wrote the solfa from the notes. It has not yet been checked against a printed hymn book.

Questions about Intercession (Sankey)

What is the doh of Intercession (Sankey)?

In this version, in G major, doh is G. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does Intercession (Sankey) start on?

It starts on s, (D in G major). Find doh first, then sing up or down to s,.

Is Intercession (Sankey) in the public domain?

Yes. Ira David Sankey died in 1908; the tune was first published in 1860. Everyone named died before 1955 and it was published before 1929, so the tune is out of copyright in Nigeria, the UK, the EU and the United States. Modern arrangements of it can still be under copyright.
